rule: A Stop sign requires a complete stop. A Yield sign requires you to give way if necessary.
trap: Treating Yield as a full stop, or treating Stop as Yield when the road looks clear

variants.question: You approach an unsigned intersection with a Stop sign on your side. The cross road looks empty. What must you do?
options: Slow down and proceed if clear
Come to a complete stop, then proceed when safe
Yield only if another vehicle is visible
Stop only if traffic is approaching

variants.question: At a Yield sign, the intersecting road has priority. What is required?
options: Give way if necessary, then proceed
Ignore if no vehicles are visible
